summary: Private single-engine aircraft (Diamond DA40) crashed ~9:30 p.m. Sunday in difficult terrain south of Boulder (north of Eldorado Canyon State Park, south of the Flatirons); overnight SAR search after 9:42 p.m. emergency beacon alert via USAF Rescue Coordination Center; crash site located Oct 5 ~10:15 a.m. by MedEvac helicopter and Civil Air Patrol, reached by rescuers ~noon; two occupants found deceased, no survivors.
location: south of Boulder, north of Eldorado Canyon State Park (south of the Flatirons)
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Civil Air Patrol; Boulder Emergency Squad
notes: BCSO case 26-04781. NTSB leading the investigation (team on site Oct 6); Boulder County Coroner's Office conducting an independent investigation. Aircraft: Diamond DA40 per FAA via media; departed Vance Brand Airport, Longmont. Decedent names not released as of Oct 5, 2026 (pending positive ID / next-of-kin notification).
